label: First Walk — the ground remembers
candidates: You walk, and the ground remembers you — every tile you cross becomes a road that carries your color.
Walk. The ground remembers you. Every tile becomes a road, and roads carry your color forward.
Where you walk, the earth becomes road — and roads carry your color to those who travel them.
Walk across the land. Each tile you cross becomes a road. Roads carry your color.
You walk. The ground you cross becomes road, and every road now carries your color.
Walk: the tiles you cross become roads. Roads carry your color, and people will travel them.
